name: cart-animation
title: Cart Animation with Multi-Currency

overview.description: A modern, fluid add-to-cart animation with real-time multi-currency conversion support. Features elastic bounce animations, success state feedback, and a sophisticated dark theme with glassmorphism effects. Supports 4 currencies with automatic price conversion and formatting.
overview.purpose: Enhances e-commerce user experience by providing immediate visual feedback when adding products to cart, with built-in currency switching for international audiences.
overview.useCase: E-commerce product pages, online stores, shopping carts, international retail websites

visualEffects: Cart icon elastic bounce animation with rotation (0.6s cubic-bezier)
Badge counter appear with elastic scale animation
Price update with scale animation and color change to green
Button success state transformation (blue → green with checkmark)
Plus icon rotation on hover (90 degrees)
Product image zoom on card hover (scale 1.05)

keyFeatures: Real-time currency conversion with 4 currencies (EUR, USD, GBP, JPY)
Currency-specific number formatting (decimals for EUR/USD/GBP, none for JPY)
State management for cart items and total price

currencies.conversionLogic: Base price (EUR €149.99) × exchange rate = converted price

formatting.JPY: Rounded to integer with .toLocaleString('en-US') for thousands separator

howItWorks.summary: The ShoppingCart class manages cart state, currency conversion, and animations. When a user adds a product, multiple synchronized animations trigger: the button changes to a success state, the cart icon bounces with rotation, the counter badge appears with elastic scaling, and the total price updates with a color flash.
workflow: Product price converts and updates display instantly
User clicks 'Add to Cart' button - triggers addToCart()
Item added to cart array, total price incremented
Button transforms: blue → green, plus icon → checkmark, text → 'Added!'
Cart icon bounces with elastic animation (scale + rotation)
Counter badge appears/updates with elastic scale (cubic-bezier)
Total price animates: scales to 1.2x, flashes green, returns to normal
After 2 seconds, button resets to original state
Currency changes update all prices instantly with formatting

timeline: 0ms - Button changes to green success state
250ms - Price hits 1.2x scale and green color (peak)
2000ms - Button resets to original blue state

htmlStructure.cartButton: Fixed top-right with icon, counter badge, and price
htmlStructure.productCard: Centered card with image, info, price, and add button

properties: items: [] - array of cart items {name, price}
totalPrice: 0 - running total in current currency
methods: changeCurrency(event) - handles currency switching and price updates
addToCart(event) - adds item to cart and triggers animations
updateCartDisplay() - updates counter and price with formatting
animateButton(button) - changes button to success state

optimizations: Zero external libraries - minimal bundle size (~13 KB + 623 KB image)
CSS animations use GPU-accelerated properties (transform, opacity)
CSS custom properties for efficient theme switching
Efficient DOM queries cached in constructor
recommendations: Optimize product image to WebP format (~100 KB savings)
Implement lazy loading for product images
Consider IndexedDB for persistent cart storage
Add debouncing if multiple rapid clicks expected

features: SVG icons are decorative (no alt text needed)
improvements: Add aria-label to cart button describing count and price
Add aria-live region for cart updates announced to screen readers
Add role='status' for success state announcements
Add keyboard shortcut for currency switching
